EVAL-SC-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Transparency Schema and Contract
EVAL-SC-S1.description: Define response schema for matched_classifications including: specialty_label, NUCC_code, pipeline_origin (regex | vector | both), and optional confidence. Ensure support for multiple matches and deduplicated aggregation output.

EVAL-SC-S2.title: Implement Dual-Pipeline Attribution Logic
EVAL-SC-S2.description: Enhance specialty_service to explicitly tag each classification with its originating pipeline(s) (regex, vector, or both). Ensure deduplication preserves combined provenance and does not drop signal origin.

EVAL-SC-S3.title: Expose Specialty Transparency via Facade Contract
EVAL-SC-S3.description: Update find_care_facade and evaluate_care_facade to include matched_classifications with pipeline attribution in responses, ensuring backward compatibility and no regression in existing consumers.

EVAL-SC-S4.title: Render Specialty Match Transparency in Chat UI
EVAL-SC-S4.description: Update MessageBubble rendering to display specialties with clear explanation of origin (e.g., exact match vs semantic match), ensuring readability and alignment with chat UX patterns.

EVAL-SC-S5.title: End-to-End Tests for Specialty Match Transparency
EVAL-SC-S5.description: Implement unit tests for attribution and deduplication logic and integration tests validating full flow from specialty_service through facade to API response, including correct pipeline labeling.
